Author a theme
Create, customize, and build a theme: defineTheme, palette generation, token overrides, component style overrides,
custom variants, responsive adaptations, and production builds.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

creating-a-custom-theme         Custom themes - Use an installed built theme as the base for ordinary customization.
                                Import it into your source and pass it as `extends` to `defineTheme({extends:
                                importedTheme, ...})`. Build the result, then add the local slug. Only eject when you
                                need...
palette                         Generate a palette - Name a few seed colors and generate every shade a theme needs,
                                light and dark; `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs
                                authoring/building-blocks/themes/generate-a-palette` explains what a palette holds.
definetheme                     defineTheme - defineTheme creates a theme from explicit token overrides and optional
                                scale configs. Existing themes may use `color` to expand an accent seed into neutral,
                                surface, text, border, and related values; it is not an accent-only edit. Keep...
extending-a-theme               Extending a Theme - `extends` lets you derive a new theme from an existing one,
                                inheriting its tokens, component overrides, icons, and fonts. Only specify what you want
                                to change; everything else carries over from the base theme.
component-style-overrides       Component Style Overrides - The `components` field in defineTheme uses semantic
                                component keys and style keys, not raw CSS selectors. Use `base` for all instances,
                                `variant:value` or `stateName` for specific props/states, and let the theme pipeline
                                choose the...
custom-variants                 Custom Variants - Themes can add new prop values to any component. Any `prop:value` key
                                where the value isn't a built-in gets treated as a new variant. Use `npx
                                @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme build` to generate TypeScript augmentations for type
                                safety.
theme-adaptations               Theme Adaptations - Use `adaptations` for opt-in token, theme-local token, and component
                                changes under viewport width, primary-pointer precision, contrast preference, or motion
                                preference. Conditions in one `when` are ANDed. Rules are ordinary ordered...
adaptation-rules                Adaptation order and validation - Precedence follows rule order. Root theme values apply
                                first, then every matching rule in declaration order. A later rule may deliberately
                                restore a root value. `onDark` and `onLight` media-surface overrides apply after
                                adaptations and...
building-themes-for-production  Build a theme - `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme build` compiles a defineTheme file
                                into production-ready artifacts. Recommended for SSR apps (Next.js, Remix) where styles
                                must be present on first paint.
icon-registry                   Built themes with an icon registry - `theme build` emits an icon import when it detects
                                a named import used by the theme's `icons:` field. It does not compile that registry
                                module. Move the registry to a separate module and use a named import.
building-a-theme-family         Building a Theme Family - Use family mode when an app switches among one base theme and
                                its selected descendants. The build writes one keyed CSS file containing every member,
                                plus one keyed JavaScript module and one declaration file, beside the root source.
token-utilities                 Token Utilities - Use `tokenVar()` when a non-StyleX styling library wants a CSS
                                variable reference, and `resolveThemeTokens()` when JavaScript needs token values for a
                                specific theme and mode without React context. Themes are registered by name when...
usetheme-hook                   useTheme Hook - `useTheme()` reads the nearest Theme and effective color mode from React
                                context. Prefer `dataVars` for CSS-capable SVG and DOM values. Use this hook for canvas,
                                charts, maps, third-party configuration objects, or an SVG API that requires...
